---
title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "The examples in help usetdm, run in full"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

The two examples at the end of `help usetdm`, each followed by `describe`
so that the loaded data are visible. The [full list of datasets](index.html#available-datasets)
is on the overview page.

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
usetdm gss, clear
describe, short
<</dd_do>>
```

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
usetdm addhealth4, clear
describe, short
<</dd_do>>
```
